confusions: Grace check difficulty for reading verses at watchtower and barrow was high (DC 9) — required multiple attempts even with Fleetfoot perk (+2 grace). Unclear if this was intentional gatekeeping or if Scout wasn't the ideal class for verse path.
The third verse being inscribed on the crown was a great reveal, but the game didn't clearly signal this was discoverable before committing to an ending — I had to use the crown item to read it.
suggestions: Consider lowering verse-reading DC or giving Scouts a bonus — 3 failed grace checks felt discouraging despite having a class perk.
Signal that examining/using the crown before presenting it is an option, or make it more obvious the verse is there.
The choice between sealing/opening the barrow was interesting but only resolved in the ending text — consider showing the reeve's or priest's reaction in-game before the final choice.
Explorer note: the hunter's camp at Split Oak was never visited — consider adding a hint about what's there if it contains content.
